author: ivananishchuk.eth
content: I was starting some work on translating python to lean and verifying etheorem code against the spec the hard way but apparently we have to cease all work, the project is unnecessary anymore, and the whole team is disappointed and doesn't want to do any protocol work anymore - ethlib people decided they don't want any human input and and can just copy everything and one-shot a replacement for us with their swarm of AI agents and don't even want to pretend to play nice. Apparently, that's how EF operates these days, standard practice 🤷
